text:
ashley: Heads up — noticed a ~38% day-over-day increase in daily burn for the embed route (route: /v1/embeddings/batch). Spike started ~03:20 UTC. Any idea why? cc @sam @priya

sam: saw that too. initial guess: increased retries + larger batch sizes. pulling per-model breakdown now.

ashley: putting query in case it's helpful:
```sql
SELECT model, route, region, SUM(token_cost) as cost
FROM finops.daily_usage
WHERE date = '2026-02-22' AND route LIKE '%embed%'
GROUP BY model, route, region
ORDER BY cost DESC
```

jules: quick summary from the run — model "open-embed-xl-q4" accounts for ~65% of that route cost and shows ~2x tokens/request vs baseline. Majority of that traffic is from northamerica-east region.

priya: I see a concurrent spike in GCP network egress in northamerica-east at the same window. Could be cross-region routing or a partner replay. Pulling VPC flow logs now.

finance-bot: Alert: unusual spend pattern on route /v1/embeddings/batch — cost delta 34% vs 7d avg.

evan: could be autoscaler overshoot — we've seen noisy traffic from a retry storm turning many small requests into many backend attempts. check request size distribution:
```json
{
  "route": "/v1/embeddings/batch",
  "median_tokens": 12,
  "p95_tokens": 1024,
  "requests": 48200
}
```

sam: can we see per-model parallelism + reservation utilization? reserved capacity = 4 x A100 in NA-east for dedicated pool "ded-northamerica-east-1" assigned to project "search". want to know if hosted traffic spilled into dedicated or if dedicated fallback increased cloud egress.

kiera: capacity report shows pool "ded-northamerica-east-1" at ~98% utilization 03:10-03:40 UTC, then fallback triggered and routed to hosted, which bumped unit costs due to cross-region egress.

ashley: action plan:
- sam: run per-route, per-model, per-region cost CSV and drop in #finance
- priya: correlate network egress logs + VPC routing changes, surface any partner IPs
- evan/eng-sre: check autoscaler logs for retry storm and add temporary shields
- kiera & jules (finance): estimate incremental spend and recommend reserved vs commit adjustments

sam: uploading CSV to #finance (link): https://drive.redwood/internal/finops/1768923456-embed-breakdown.csv (placeholder)

jules: preliminary incremental cost for 24h window ≈ $12.4k. If this is a one-off replay, reserved capacity won't help. If recurring steady delta ~30%+, reserved+commit saves materially.

priya: found a misconfigured partner endpoint that replayed small payloads in bursts — they sent many tiny files which triggered frequent small embedding calls. Reached out to partner to stop/retry batching.

ashley: thanks. if partner confirms, ask them to batch client-side or use a streaming endpoint. Also consider opening billing dispute for network egress if partner is at fault.

evan: I'll add a temporary throttle for requests < 32 tokens and drop immediate retries to reduce blast radius.

kiera: finance note — if this pattern repeated monthly, incremental burn ~ $370k/mo. Suggest threshold: if per-route monthly delta > $50k for two consecutive weeks, finance will propose reserved commitments and present ROI.

ashley: agreed. sam/priya/evan update by EOD. kiera & jules will draft partner comms and add a per-model slice view to the FinOps dashboard (daily + 7d trend).

ashley: thanks everyone :thumbsup:

priya: partner confirmed, will pause replays and update by 1500 PT.

jules: added a temporary dashboard card: per-model per-route burn + delta vs rolling 7d. sharing snapshot in #finance.

ashley: closing note — great detection. This one is a mix of partner misuse + fallback routing costs. We'll track and, if recurring, move to committed capacity conversation.

kiera: noted, will run a commit cost-savings calc if we see sustained trend.

ashley: closing thread for now. React if you need follow-ups.
